description: Silero Voice Activity Detection (VAD) - a 4-layer CNN + decoder-head VAD model for speech/silence detection in 16kHz audio.

runtime.version_source: Silero VAD upstream release family (snakers4/silero-vad tag v6.2, GitHub)
runtime.engine_note: Engine runtime (src/models/silero_vad/runtime.cpp) loads safetensors with tinygrad-style keys (stft_conv.weight, conv1.weight, ..., lstm_cell.weight_ih/hh, ..., final_conv.bias). Bundled safetensors generated from the official v6.2 jit checkpoint (silero_vad_v62.jit) via scripts/fetch_silero_vad.py. NOTE: upstream tinygrad safetensors (silero_vad_16k.safetensors on snakers4 master, added 2025-12-10) is a divergent export that does NOT match v6.2 jit weights (see snakers4/silero-vad issue #768); the bundled asset must stay the generated v6.2 one.
